_approach: The reverse-cymbal moment Myloops calls 'the single most reliable arrival cue in the genre': a crash cannot literally reverse inside a step sequencer, so the swell is approximated as a steadily accelerating, steadily rising run of crash/ride hits across the last bar (sparse 8ths climbing to a dense 16th run) whose velocity ramps from a whisper to 127, landing its loudest hit exactly on the downbeat where a true reverse-cymbal sample would peak. Kick and clap hold the groove in bar 1, then drop out in bar 2 to leave the swell alone.
